title: Print a message
instructions_md:
## Show text on the screen

`print()` shows a line of text. The text goes inside quotes. Python calls text in quotes a **string**.

```python
print("Good morning!")
```

```text
Good morning!
```

## Your task

Print this line:

`I am learning Python.`
hints: You need one line of code.
Use `print()` and put the sentence inside quotes.
Write `print("...")` and replace the three dots with the sentence.
starter_code: # Write your code below this line.
